text:
maya: Heads up — I have two different orientation invites for tomorrow, one shows 9:00 AM PST and another shows 5:00 PM GMT, and the Zoom links are different. Which one is the canonical event?

sam: Ugh, thanks for flagging. We rotated the recurrence while updating hosts and that accidentally created a duplicate series. The canonical one is the "Orientation - Global" event sent from onboarding@redwood.com (https://join.zoom.us/j/123456789). The duplicate is safe to decline.

lia: If you're in APAC we also have regional repeats — pick whichever slot works, but let us know if you want moved to the next cohort.

maya: How do we know which session will be recorded and where the recording ends up? I accepted both invites so not sure which will have the cloud recording.

onboarding-bot: Recording info: Zoom cloud recording enabled. Recordings auto-post to #new-hires and are archived to s3://redwood-onboarding/recordings/YYYYMMDD.

sam: Practically: only the canonical event (hosted by orientation@redwood.com) will have the cloud recording attached. The duplicate was created under a different host account so its link won't get the final recording.

natalie: Could the .ics import be the root cause? Outlook often mishandles recurring-event timezones and ends up duplicating.

maya: Yep — I think I imported both .ics files. Outlook now shows one as "floating" (no tz). Any quick fixes?

tom: Quick workaround that works in Outlook web: Edit the event, open the timezone dropdown, explicitly set it to "(UTC-08:00) Pacific Time (US & Canada)", then Save. That forces the correct conversion. If you're on desktop Outlook, re-subscribe using the calendar URL instead of attaching the .ics.

lia: We'll remove the duplicate series from the org calendar, but we can't automatically delete accepted events from everyone's calendars, so please decline the stale invite when you see it.

maya: Thanks — and will the recording include captions/transcript? Accessibility is important.

sam: Yes, cloud captions are enabled for all orientation sessions and Zoom generates an audio transcript. If you need a speaker-separated transcript or a longer retention copy, DM me and I'll ask L10 ops to generate/export it.

onboarding-bot: Tip: to receive the recording link via email, add the tag `send-recording` to your onboarding profile or DM @onboarding-bot with your cohort.

maya: One last question — the follow-up Q&A event: is that scheduled in everyone's local timezone or anchored to host timezone?

lia: We'll publish multiple Q&A slots across regions next week. The Q&A invites are separate events anchored to the host timezone, but we will add East/West/APAC repeating blocks so local times are explicit.

natalie: I'll re-send updated invites in ~10 minutes with the canonical Zoom link, explicit timezone labels (e.g., "9:00 AM PT / 5:00 PM GMT"), and a note about which event gets the recording.

maya: Awesome, appreciate it! :pray:

sam: pinging @people-ops for any cohort moves or late reschedules.

people-ops: Noted — we'll coordinate swaps. If you need to move cohorts, please fill the cohort switch form: https://bit.ly/redwood-cohort-switch

---

Example problematic ICS snippet (for context):

```
BEGIN:VCALENDAR
METHOD:REQUEST
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:orient-dup-2024-09-01
DTSTAMP:20240901T160000Z
DTSTART:20240901T090000
DTEND:20240901T103000
TZID:Floating
SUMMARY:Redwood Orientation
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
```

If you imported that one it will appear "floating" in Outlook. Decline the floating/duplicate event and keep the one from onboarding@redwood.com. If anything still looks off after Natalie resends, drop a DM here and we'll sort it out.
